objective.codec: universal expert-local SwiGLU Gate/Up/Down-transposed PTQ refinement

scalable_search.support: one device lexsort over block-specific valid-coordinate correlations and norms
scalable_search.linear_systems: all 14 rank prefixes packed into one (blocks*14)x14x14 solve
scalable_search.candidate_reconstruction: all packet-canonical coefficient states reconstructed by one Bx14x4096 einsum
scalable_search.winner_metric: direct valid-coordinate FP64 SSE of canonical packet state
scalable_search.device_host_boundary: one bulk winner-metadata transfer and one bulk summary transfer per role
scalable_search.dictionary_reuse: one immutable dictionary shared by source roles, literal replay, phase control and all Gaussian controls

canonical_gaussian.law: mathematical Box-Muller transform of independent 53-bit midpoint uniforms
canonical_gaussian.canonicalization: host FP64 transform, one IEEE binary32 rounding, exact binary64 widening
canonical_gaussian.backend_contract: serialized binary64 bytes are generated once on host and copied unchanged to NumPy or CuPy
canonical_gaussian.finite_prng_boundary: a finite Monte-Carlo realization, not a claim of continuous finite support

target_rate_fixture.controls_required: one phase plus eight canonical Gaussian full searches
target_rate_fixture.source: source-free exact Ramanujan atoms with zero synthetic coarse reconstruction

authority.coarse_decoder: runtime class source, decoder manifest, auditor manifest, capability and independent PASS receipt all opened and hash bound
authority.literal_decode: coarse decoder receives only decoded coarse bytes, public dimensions and role order; output must equal independent per-role FP32 hashes
authority.shape_cap: positive uint32 dimensions, uint32 block counts, uint64 payload lengths, integer-only page rounding
authority.closure: external hash-pinned bootstrap verifier loads no package code and rejects every extra/missing/nested entry

claim_boundary: no Qwen result, target performance result, physical storage telemetry, HBM measurement or portability claim
